biography: My passion is in large projects with passionate teams.  Seeing an idea or thought developed into a tangible, operating facility is extremely gratifying yet challenging.  Projects are like puzzles, and I feel most rewarded by my work when I see pieces of the puzzle fit together by a team that has developed well together.  Also, being part of today's energy sector allows me to see how my efforts directly improve the lives of my family and my neighbors on a daily basis.
